_help: Hand corrections applied by build_quijote_atlas.py. Key each entry by arXiv ID (e.g. 1909.05273),
ADS bibcode, or the paper's title as it appears on the Quijote publications page.
Fields (all optional): topic (exact topic name, or 'Unassigned (new papers)'), date ('2025', '2025-06'
or '2025-06-30'), abstract, url, link (label of the link), title, authors (list of names),
hide (true leaves the entry out of the site), comment (free text, ignored).
Keys starting with '_' are ignored. The build reports every correction it applies.
